Class CharCreate

java.lang.Object
CharCreate
public class CharCreate extends Object
The CharCreate class facilitates the creation of a character in a game. It allows the player to set the character's name, select a job class, and displays and sets character statistics. It includes methods for setting the character's name, selecting a job class, confirming character creation, getting character information, displaying character details, and setting initial statistics based on the chosen job class. The class utilizes a list of predefined job classes and handles user input with exception handling.
